lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Just that paper towel that he dried his hands with.

lines.speaker: FASSEBENDER
lines.text: After you cut her throat, was she still alive?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Barely.

lines.speaker: FASSEBENDER
lines.text: And how do you know that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Cuz she was breathing like little bit.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: When do you think she quit breathing?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: When we were bringing her outside.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Outside, what do you mean outside where?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Out in the garage.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How do you know she quit breathing then?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Cuz her belly wasn’t moving.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Cuz her belly wasn’t moving? (Brendan nods “yes”) OK.

lines.speaker: FASSEBENDER
lines.text: You talked about getting a car seat and a cabinet. (Brendan nods “yes”) Whose idea was that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: His.

lines.speaker: FASSEBENDER
lines.text: When you went and got it, put it by the fire, did you throw it on the fire when it was time to throw it on the fire?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (nods “yes”) uh huh. With hi-him.

lines.speaker: FASSEBENDER
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He helped me throw it on there.

lines.speaker: FASSEBENDER
lines.text: The car seat?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (nods “yes”) uh huh.
